title: Generic linear instrumental variable
content: Figure 7.9 adds path coefficients to the generic instrumental-variable graph. Z affects X by a, X affects Y by b, and hidden U affects X and Y by c and d.

variables.name: U
variables.content: The unobserved common cause of X and Y.

arrows.because: Figure 7.9 labels the instrument-to-treatment path a.
Figure 7.9 labels the treatment effect b.
Figure 7.9 labels hidden confounding into X by c.
Figure 7.9 labels hidden confounding into Y by d.
